name: officetopdf
description: Command-line utility for converting Microsoft Office documents to PDF format

tools.description: Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint documents to PDF using Microsoft Office automation
tools.usage:
OfficeToPDF.exe document.docx output.pdf # Convert Word to PDF
OfficeToPDF.exe spreadsheet.xlsx report.pdf # Convert Excel to PDF
OfficeToPDF.exe presentation.pptx slides.pdf # Convert PowerPoint to PDF
OfficeToPDF.exe /bookmarks document.docx bookmarked.pdf # Include bookmarks
